title: Compilation of the Divan of Hafez
summary: After the poet Hafez died in Shiraz around 1389 or 1390, a contemporary named Mohammad Golandam collected his scattered ghazals and wrote a preface to the collection. One source dates the compilation to 1410, some 21 to 22 years after the poet's death. Scholars note that the early sources were many, so a single true text is unlikely to be recovered.

uncertainty.note: Only Iran Chamber gives 1410; Encyclopaedia Iranica says only that the collection was made after Hafez's death (ca. 792/1390).

as_recorded.value: Hafez died at the age of 70 (1389 CE)

where.historical_name: Shiraz, Persia (proxy pin: no opened source says where the Divan was compiled)

importance.justification: The standard collection of the poems of Hafez, one of the most influential poets of Persia.
